title: Nitrogen ns-pulse DBD – 1-minute demo
description: Coarse-grid version (Nx = 400, dt = 2.5 ps, adaptive sub-stepping) of the paper's nitrogen DBD benchmark (20 kV, 15 ns Gaussian pulse, 60 Torr, quartz barriers). Runs in about a minute; use the case defaults (Nx = 1000, dt = 1 ps) for converged results.
